enchantments.tooltip: Exceptional Universal Spell Lore: 5% Exceptional bonus to Universal Spell Lore.
Exceptional Potency +15: Passive: +15 Exceptional bonus to each Spell Power.
Insightful Spell Focus Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of all spells.

Legendary Nightmare Guard: On being hit or missed, this item has a chance to attempt to fear your enemy, ripping the life from them as if they were struck with a Phantasmal Killer spell. Enemies must make a DC 100 Will save versus the Fear or a DC 100 Fortitude save versus Death or be slain. Even if they make their save versus Death, they may still be feared.
Mind Drain: This item reduces your maximum spell points by 5% while equipped.
Will Save -2: This item gives a -2 penalty to your Will saves.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
